title: Godot Editor crashes when changing `VideoStreamPlayer`'s properties
body:
### Tested versions

Linux Mint 21.3 (Virginia)
Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-8100 CPU @ 3.60GHz (4 threads) - 31.21 GiB memory

Could not test on other versions yet

### System information

Linux Mint 21.3 (Virginia) - Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-8100 CPU @ 3.60GHz (4 threads) - 31.21 GiB memory

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce (if possible)
VideoStreamPlayer: Set file to .ogg file
Save and close Godot Engine (Not sure this is necessary) 
Open Godot Engine
VideoStreamPlayer:  Click in file input and press any key then it crash out
